title: SB 1126 (109th General Assembly): As introduced, permits the use of a photo identification card issued by this state, the United States, or an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state for purposes of verifying the identity of an eligible voter. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(2) (replaced)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card issued by this state, or the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification; provided, that such identification card contains a photograph of the voter;
(section) TCA 2-7-112(c)(8) (new)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state; provided, that such identification card contains a photograph of the voter.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 1: replaces item (2) of the accepted-ID list in 2-7-112(c) (state or federal ID card with a photograph).
(other) Section 2: adds a new item to the list for a photo ID card from an accredited in-state college or university.
(other) Last section: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 1121898 (2015-02-12): only version saved; same text as HB 926 (slot a only).
(other) note: Companion HB 926. Stopped after referral to Senate State and Local Government Committee; no votes. No amendments saved.
